scope: Single-seed PDF capacity group changes width, head count, feedforward width, parameter count and initialization/random consumption together. Data, MAE, source weight and training schedule remain fixed. Same integer seed does not imply matching weights, constructor RNG or dropout streams across capacities. This is not an isolated width effect or a unique biological mechanism. Production CUDA remains nondeterministic as in the parent. Food-group intervals condition on selected checkpoints, not seed-population, label-validity, repeated selection or transfer uncertainty. Screening cannot accept a final model.
